info.name: 1Factory Customers API
info.description:
This API allows you to create and query a number of objects in your 1Factory account.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: support@1factory.com

item.name: 1Factory Gets a List of Plans Shared with Your Organization by Your Customers

query.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).
The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.
Part name / number to filter on.
Part rev to filter on. Typically used in conjunction with the part_number query parameter.
Status to filter on.

The status of an object that requires approval before releasing or closing.

(Availability depends on Organization settings.)

If tabulated plans should be filtered on.

Return objects created before the specified date-time

request.description:
The list of customer plans can be filtered by specifying query parameters.

Paging parameters control the number of rows Plan objects returned. By default, the first 100 plans are returned.

response.name: Returns a list of plans, most recently updated first. Utilize paging query parameters to query older plans. By default the 100 most recent are returned.

item.name: 1Factory Gets a List of Inspections Shared with Your Organization by Your…

query.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).
The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.
Part name / number to filter on.
Part rev to filter on. Typically used in conjunction with the part_number query parameter.
Primary identifier to filter on for an inspection or FAI, for example a Work Order or Purchase Order. For FAIs, this is the 'FAI Number'.
Secondary identifier to filter on for an inspection or FAI, for example a Customer Purchase Order or Lot #. For FAIs this is the 'PO Number'.
Name of customer to filter on.
Inspection status to filter on.
Return only approved or rejected objects closed after the specified date-time.
Review status to filter on.
